name: FloatingInput
description: A text field whose label glides up and shrinks when focused or filled, with an animated accent focus ring, helper or error text that cross-fades in place, and an optional clear button that pops in once there is a value.
a11yNotes: Uses a native <input> with a real <label htmlFor> as its accessible name. Helper/error text is linked with aria-describedby inside a polite live region; invalid sets aria-invalid and required sets aria-required (the visual asterisk is aria-hidden). The clear button is a labelled native button ('Clear <label>') and Escape also clears the value; focus returns to the input. Under prefers-reduced-motion the label and messages change without movement.

defaultProps.label: Email address
defaultProps.helperText: We'll only use this to send you receipts.
defaultProps.errorText: Please enter a valid email address.

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the next value on every edit and with an empty string when cleared.

propsApi.description: Floating label text; also the accessible name.

propsApi.name: errorText
propsApi.description: Message shown instead of the helper when invalid is true.
